forms.title: Cave Dragon
forms.requires: verified cave dragon state; no other dragon species
forms.identity: Excavator, armored bruiser, and underground apex predator

nodes.label: Stone Claws
nodes.effect: Scale unarmed/claw damage only in dragon body; no weapon-wide bonus.

nodes.label: Crushing Bite
nodes.effect: Bounded armor/knockback pressure on confirmed bite hits.

nodes.label: Seismic Pounce
nodes.effect: Cooldown-limited landing shockwave against entities; terrain damage off by default.

nodes.label: Stonehide
nodes.effect: Incremental natural armor; respect equipment stacking caps.

nodes.label: Earthbound Poise
nodes.effect: Reduce knockback and fall damage while grounded.

nodes.label: Mountain Bastion
nodes.effect: Short defensive stance with a resource cost and meaningful cooldown, not permanent immunity.

nodes.label: Tunneler
nodes.effect: Improve legal claw-mining speed; preserve vanilla/tool harvest checks.

nodes.label: Vein Sense
nodes.effect: Short-range, timed ore awareness without unrestricted x-ray or chunk scans.

nodes.label: Deep Excavation
nodes.effect: Controlled multi-block excavation; count actual blocks, honor claims and server limits.

nodes.label: Gloom Eyes
nodes.effect: Improve dark navigation without permanent global spectral vision.

nodes.label: Echo Sense
nodes.effect: Detect nearby moving creatures underground on a cooldown.

nodes.label: Deep Sovereignty
nodes.effect: Situational breath or body-power enhancement underground; preserve native dragon-breath identity.

capstone.label: Heart of the Mountain
capstone.effect: After late native dragon progression, briefly combine armor and excavation benefits; no Chaos Guardian-tier gear replacement.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: No cross-species dragon purchases or free dragon growth.
Mining benefits must not bypass protected ores, world claims or late-game materials.

forms.title: Sea Dragon
forms.requires: verified sea dragon state; no other dragon species
forms.identity: High-mobility aquatic spellfighter and ocean explorer

nodes.label: Current Rider
nodes.effect: Improve movement control in water, including currents.

nodes.label: Tidal Strike
nodes.effect: Enhance wet-target combat and native aquatic attacks, not generic damage.

nodes.label: Undertow
nodes.effect: Cooldown-limited pull/slow applied to legal targets without moving world water blocks.

nodes.label: Pressure Adaptation
nodes.effect: Reduce underwater environmental penalties.

nodes.label: Brine Scales
nodes.effect: Situational protection while submerged; no blanket armor bonus on land.

nodes.label: Deepwater Refuge
nodes.effect: Bounded underwater healing or defense with a meaningful resource/cooldown cost.

nodes.label: Sleek Form
nodes.effect: Increase underwater speed, capped against sprint/exotic gear.

nodes.label: Slipstream
nodes.effect: Short burst dodge in water with collision safety.

nodes.label: Ocean Leap
nodes.effect: Leap from water and control reentry without free flight.

nodes.label: Ocean Forager
nodes.effect: Enhance valid fish/seafood gathering and food utility without infinite loot.

nodes.label: Friendly Waters
nodes.effect: Improve interactions with eligible nonhostile aquatic mobs; no boss pacification.

nodes.label: Abyssal Explorer
nodes.effect: Safe short-duration navigation/sensing in deep oceans.

capstone.label: Tide Sovereign
capstone.effect: Late-game, time-limited aquatic combat and mobility surge; must be distinctly weaker on land.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Retain Sea Dragon's existing sushi/magical-food compatibility fixes as separate diet logic.
No free permanent underwater invulnerability or world fluid griefing.

forms.title: Forest Dragon
forms.requires: verified forest dragon state; no other dragon species
forms.identity: Nature guardian, mobile skirmisher and ecological support

nodes.label: Green Recovery
nodes.effect: Small recovery benefit in living biomes, not in all dimensions.

nodes.label: Living Bark
nodes.effect: Situational natural defense near vegetation, with stacking caps.

nodes.label: Elder Grove
nodes.effect: Time-limited regeneration/support pulse, costing dragon resource.

nodes.label: Bramble Claw
nodes.effect: Add a bounded nature-themed status to confirmed claw attacks.

nodes.label: Entangling Breath
nodes.effect: Native breath enhancer applying short slows only where source breath supports it.

nodes.label: Thornstorm
nodes.effect: Cooldown-limited small-area crowd control with no world block destruction.

nodes.label: Canopy Stride
nodes.effect: Improve movement through leaves/forests; no generic always-on sprint power.

nodes.label: Rooted Landing
nodes.effect: Safer falls and precision landings, capped by equipment.

nodes.label: Sylvan Bound
nodes.effect: Short leap between safe landing points; collision and claim checks.

nodes.label: Fey Courtesy
nodes.effect: Conditional neutrality with selected eligible fae mobs, excluding hostile bosses.

nodes.label: Harvest Harmony
nodes.effect: Quality-of-life harvest/replant assistance without resource multiplication.

nodes.label: Grove Guardian
nodes.effect: Bounded support bonus to nearby allies and pets in natural environments.

capstone.label: Elderwood Heart
capstone.effect: Late native progression grants a timed defensive/support state in forest biomes.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Do not turn Forest Dragon neutrality into global creature pacification.
Sourceberries and modded enchanted golden carrot diets are separate food tags, not a skill gate.

forms.title: Vampire
forms.requires: unified vampire state recognized by transformation bridge; retains both native provider progressions
forms.identity: Blood economy, predatory stealth and undead survival

nodes.label: Efficient Feeding
nodes.effect: Improve real blood gained from eligible feeding transactions; cannot create blood from empty actions.

nodes.label: Deep Reservoir
nodes.effect: Increase one authoritative usable blood capacity, not two independent HUD pools.

nodes.label: Crimson Renewal
nodes.effect: Trade a real measured blood debit for bounded emergency healing.

nodes.label: Nocturnal Vision
nodes.effect: Better low-light perception with native-sunlight penalties untouched.

nodes.label: Shadow Stalker
nodes.effect: Short stealth advantage in darkness; avoid invisibility in full daylight.

nodes.label: Bat Mastery
nodes.effect: Improve native bat-form controls/efficiency after that native ability is acquired.

nodes.label: Fang Training
nodes.effect: Scale only verified vampire bite/melee attacks.

nodes.label: Measured Feast
nodes.effect: Limited post-kill blood recovery from eligible kills, with transaction deduplication.

nodes.label: Blood Duelist
nodes.effect: Focused single-target bonuses under low blood; prevent intentional zero-cost loops.

nodes.label: Pale Resilience
nodes.effect: Bounded poison/disease-type mitigation where the source system allows it.

nodes.label: Sunshroud
nodes.effect: Short resource-funded sunlight resistance; never erase core daylight tradeoffs.

nodes.label: Elder Presence
nodes.effect: Bounded defensive/control aura with cooldown, not full charm immunity.

capstone.label: Blood Regent
capstone.effect: Blood-funded high-tier predatory stance requiring advanced native vampire progression.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: One canonical blood owner; no dual-pool double gains or duplicate feeding rewards.
Cure suspends effects without deleting invested ranks; JAWR blood HUD bug must be fixed independently.

forms.title: Werewolf
forms.requires: unified werewolf/lycanthrope state; exact physiology owner remains unselected
forms.identity: Hunter, sprinter, brawler and pack leader

nodes.label: Keen Scent
nodes.effect: Locate nearby tracked targets at limited range, not players through claims or walls without rule.

nodes.label: Blood Trail
nodes.effect: Brief tracking of wounded mobs with privacy/multiplayer restrictions.

nodes.label: Apex Tracker
nodes.effect: Improved tracking against eligible dangerous mobs, cooldown limited.

nodes.label: Rending Claws
nodes.effect: Scale claw damage in valid wolf/beast form, respecting weapon modifiers.

nodes.label: Savage Momentum
nodes.effect: Short stacking melee bonus after actual hits, capped and reset out of combat.

nodes.label: Primal Fury
nodes.effect: Timed burst consuming native appropriate resource or applying fatigue.

nodes.label: Predator's Stride
nodes.effect: Bonus mobility in valid wolf form.

nodes.label: Pouncing Leap
nodes.effect: Targeted controlled leap with landing safety.

nodes.label: Lunar Chase
nodes.effect: Short chase burst under moon conditions with weaker daytime counterpart.

nodes.label: Pack Sense
nodes.effect: Detect/coordinate eligible allied wolves and player-owned companions.

nodes.label: Protect the Pack
nodes.effect: Bounded defense near allies, no pet invulnerability.

nodes.label: War Howl
nodes.effect: Cooldown-limited temporary group buff; only one stacking instance per leader.

capstone.label: Moon Apex
capstone.effect: Late-form transformation mastery for a short ferocious burst, preserving silver/other verified weaknesses.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Do not commit to Werewolves vs JAWR hunger, model or forced-moon authority before the physiology audit.
Natural form-change progression remains native, not purchased again in Tyz.

forms.title: Lich
forms.requires: verified Goety or JAWR/Forbidden Magic lich state; also Archlich and valid Dracolich

nodes.label: Soul Conservation
nodes.effect: Lower eligible personal necromancy spell costs, not global ritual/machine cost.

nodes.label: Soul Reserve
nodes.effect: Bounded native personal soul/Arca resource capacity where extensible.

nodes.label: Soul Treasury
nodes.effect: Small high-level sustain on committed necromantic actions, no passive self-funding loop.

nodes.label: Grave Touch
nodes.effect: Scalable effect on verified lich necrotic spell/melee attacks only.

nodes.label: Lingering Curse
nodes.effect: Bounded duration of attributable lich debuffs, not a global potion multiplier.

nodes.label: Dread Conduit
nodes.effect: Strengthen source-verified lich spell lines without unlocking forbidden research.

nodes.label: Bone Captain
nodes.effect: Modest bonus to personally owned undead servants.

nodes.label: Grave Regiment
nodes.effect: Improved servant coordination/leash and bounded count efficiency.

nodes.label: Death Host
nodes.effect: Late temporary enhancement to current owned minions with hard entity budget.

nodes.label: Cold Persistence
nodes.effect: Limited tolerance of wither/undead hazards, preserving explicit weaknesses.

nodes.label: Anchor Attunement
nodes.effect: Improve diagnostics or controlled anchor maintenance; never bypass native phylactery/Arca cost.

nodes.label: Final Passage
nodes.effect: Minor post-rescue recovery *after* an authoritative successful resurrection; no extra death-save trigger.

capstone.label: Sovereign of Ash
capstone.effect: High-tier necromantic command stance requiring advanced lich progression and stable anchor ownership.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Goety and Forbidden Magic advancement remain separate native tracks; this Tyz category is shared once.
For Archlich: phylactery rescue first, Arca only on failed phylactery; never duplicate saves.
For Dracolich, the same one Lich Tyz category may coexist with exactly one dragon species.

forms.title: Hunter
forms.requires: verified Vampirism hunter faction; mutually exclusive with supernatural states
forms.identity: Prepared anti-supernatural specialist, scouting and counterplay

nodes.label: Monster Lore
nodes.effect: Reveal eligible hostile supernatural type/weakness cues after actual observation.

nodes.label: Quarry Mark
nodes.effect: Mark one tracked supernatural target, with limited range and duration.

nodes.label: Master Pursuit
nodes.effect: Improved tracking of wounded or fleeing marked targets, respecting concealment rules.

nodes.label: Silver Discipline
nodes.effect: Bounded bonus using verified anti-supernatural material/weapon tags.

nodes.label: Weak-Point Strike
nodes.effect: Conditional bonus after observing a marked target, not global crit multiplier.

nodes.label: Slayer's Technique
nodes.effect: Cooldown-limited counterattack against specific supernatural telegraphs.

nodes.label: Steadfast Mind
nodes.effect: Limited resistance to eligible charm/fear/supernatural debuffs.

nodes.label: Warding Kit
nodes.effect: Improve duration/efficacy of approved consumable anti-monster items, not free production.

nodes.label: Hexbreaker
nodes.effect: Resource-cost/cooldown supernatural cleanse of eligible effects; not boss dispel.

nodes.label: Fieldcraft
nodes.effect: Short preparation-speed and stealth bonuses in natural environments.

nodes.label: Consecrated Snare
nodes.effect: Craft/use a bounded anti-monster trap; ownership and claim-safe placement.

nodes.label: Spell Intercept
nodes.effect: High-tier, timed interrupt window for verified hostile supernatural casts; bosses exempt unless explicitly whitelisted.

capstone.label: Master Slayer
capstone.effect: Late hunter-only preparation stance combining marks and counterattacks against supernatural mobs.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Hunter purchases never require vampire, wolf, or lich powers.
Voluntary hunter-replacement ceremony suspends these effects and retains historical ranks for later valid return.

forms.title: Monk
forms.requires: valid tmm_monk native faction plus equipment-discipline condition on use; tier licenses from native Monk tree
forms.identity: Unarmed martial arts, unarmored body, motion and hand-harvest specialization

nodes.label: Empty-Hand Force
nodes.effect: Repeatable empty-hand damage bonus beyond the native +1 Open Palm unlock; stacking cap.

nodes.label: Flowing Counter
nodes.effect: Bounded counterattack after a verified native Guarding Palm/parry unlock.

nodes.label: Spirit Bolt Mastery
nodes.effect: Boost native spirit projectile after its native rank-6 license, not duplicate its unlock.

nodes.label: Natural Poise
nodes.effect: Scale unarmored protection beyond native Unarmored Poise +2; never scale equipped armor.

nodes.label: Hunger Discipline
nodes.effect: Bounded food/exhaustion efficiency after native license; do not remove all hunger.

nodes.label: Fire & Blast Tempering
nodes.effect: Limited environmental damage mitigation after both matching native licenses.

nodes.label: Body Speed
nodes.effect: Repeatable speed under no conventional gear discipline; native Fleet Footwork remains a one-off.

nodes.label: Balanced Landing
nodes.effect: Fall/knockback control; native Step Assist remains a one-off in native tree.

nodes.label: Glide Control
nodes.effect: Improve native momentum gliding only after rank-15 native unlock; never creative flight.

nodes.label: Barehand Efficiency
nodes.effect: Repeatable hand-mining speed; native Stone/Iron/Diamond/Netherite Fist unlock legal harvest tiers.

nodes.label: Fortunate Hands
nodes.effect: Bounded fortune-like bonus only after native rank-13 license and legitimate drop event.

nodes.label: Looting Palm
nodes.effect: Bounded unarmed looting after native rank-9 license; no creature-drop duplication.

capstone.label: Empty-Hand Paragon
capstone.effect: After native rank 20 and late achievements, an equipment-restricted burst of unarmed prowess; avoid eclipsing Draconic/Gem armor.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Preserve the Monk native full skeleton (50 nodes, 6 pilot nodes) and 47 Monk-specific Tyz candidates as source inventories, NOT 47 new compulsory live skills.
First Sunset and native mastery from barehand breaks, kills and first foods stay separate from MXP global awards.
Step Assist after Fleet Footwork, not at rank one. Tool-free harvest tiers remain native permission unlocks.

hybrid_policy.dracolich: one dragon species plus one lich category
hybrid_policy.abomination: defer combined skill design until native physiology passes

status_caveat: All form nodes and capstones are conceptual; no live config or gameplay changed.

dependency_contract.advanced: at least 1 rank of same-lane entry node plus verified native mid-stage
dependency_contract.mastery: at least 1 rank of same-lane advanced node plus verified native late-stage
dependency_contract.capstone: at least 1 rank in any mastery node AND 1 rank in an advanced node from a different lane; plus final native progression and independently verified late milestone
dependency_contract.prerequisite_refunds: deny predecessor refund if dependent downstream ranks remain owned; do not silently erase purchases
